cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

mechanism: A treats tentative moving help as a professional scheduling exercise, correcting B priorities and judging limited availability as an unspoken loyalty measure.
confusable: Ordinary contingency planning lacks the personal value judgements attached to each response despite no actual move date.
comparison: Photo alternative tests presentation preference; moving alternative tests reserved time and phone priority.
seedUse: Friday/phone seed supplies the small escalating tests; S03 corrects scheduling precision instead of claiming general standards.
